long_biography.plain_text:
Jose Benito Sardinas Jr. built a career creating aircraft-services businesses with longtime partners Mario Catalano and Octavio Silva. Before 1st Choice Aerospace, the group created and sold High Tech Avionics & Accessories and a second enterprise acquired by Wencor Group.

At 1st Choice, Sardinas served as president while the company expanded FAA- and EASA-certified component repair from Kentucky into South Florida. Its teams supported pneumatic, fuel, electrical, seating, oxygen, cargo and waste systems for commercial, cargo and military aircraft. The business grew to 176 employees before a 2019 sale, with Sardinas remaining during the ownership transition.
long_biography.html:
Jose Benito Sardinas Jr. built a career creating aircraft-services businesses with longtime partners Mario Catalano and Octavio Silva. Before 1st Choice Aerospace, the group created and sold High Tech Avionics & Accessories and a second enterprise acquired by Wencor Group.

At 1st Choice, Sardinas served as president while the company expanded FAA- and EASA-certified component repair from Kentucky into South Florida. Its teams supported pneumatic, fuel, electrical, seating, oxygen, cargo and waste systems for commercial, cargo and military aircraft. The business grew to 176 employees before a 2019 sale, with Sardinas remaining during the ownership transition.
